Label: Light Triad Scale
Description: Light Triad Scale (LTS). Measures the light triad of personality (Kantianism, humanism, faith in humanity). 24 items as administered, 5-point scale. Reference: Kaufman, S. B., Yaden, D. B., Hyde, E., & Tsukayama, E. (2019). The Light vs. Dark Triad of Personality: Contrasting Two Very Different Profiles of Human Nature. Frontiers in Psychology, 10, 467.
